statement: SDL 3.2.10, Original with MotionPlus and Nunchuk: 0 gyro events and 0 nonzero gyro events, 1 joystick removals, and 5035 of 5042 disconnected polls. Final cached presence 0, mode 0x00. Initialization read active mode 0x05 and issued the reset. Linux activation was bypassed. The post-reset initialization and open reads consumed interleaved responses. SDL advertised no gyro and removed the joystick on the extension-status path before receiving a valid gyro-marked report during drive. The kernel holder saw changing gyro.

applicability.revision: Original with MotionPlus and Nunchuk; virtualgamepad 74ff69b, SDL 3.2.10, Linux 7.3.0-1-mainline
applicability.scope: Consumer evidence from one synthetic virtual-device arm with the Linux kernel driver bound. No claim about physical units or other acquisition arrangements.
